(Part 2, paragraph beginning "Identifying overload")
findings.source_quote: Are you declining a request because life is too full, or is it an excuse?

findings.location:
Household duties and caring for our families fill our days. Sometimes those tasks alone make us extremely busy.

(Part 1, paragraph beginning "Household duties")
findings.source_quote: Sometimes those tasks alone make us extremely busy.
findings.suggested_fix: Adjust wording to a more natural Swedish equivalent that retains the same meaning. Example: "Ibland gör bara dessa uppgifter oss extremt upptagna."
findings.translation_quote: Ibland gör de uppgifterna oss ensamma extremt upptagna.

findings.location:
Symptoms of overload can include lack of sleep, strained relationships, procrastination, fear of failure, and a susceptible immune system.

(Part 2, paragraph beginning "No one can overextend themselves indefinitely.")
findings.suggested_fix: Render the phrase in idiomatic Swedish to convey weakened immune function. Example: "ett försvagat immunförsvar" or "överkänsligt immunsystem" depending on preferred idiom.

findings.location:
